summary: 放飞实验区分出三种归巢能力：寻找熟悉地标、保持既定航向，以及偏离原路后重新定位。对不同物种和年龄的比较，又揭示了先天方向感与经验在迁徙中的不同作用。
logic: 椋鸟幼鸟与成鸟的差异

paragraphs.brief: 金斑鸻万里迁徙的航向精度
sentences: For many of us, the way birds are able to orientate is both astounding and difficult to appreciate fully.
对许多人来说，鸟类辨别方向的本领令人惊叹，也很难完全理解。

For instance, the annual migration of the golden plover of the Pacific takes it from Alaska to Hawaii on a flight of well over 3,000 kilometres, and if it were to deviate by only one degree, it would miss the island on which it nests.
例如，太平洋金斑鸻每年从阿拉斯加迁徙到夏威夷，单程远超 3,000 公里；飞行方向只要偏差一度，就会错过它筑巢的岛屿。
paragraphs.gist: 金斑鸻飞越三千多公里海面寻找筑巢小岛，航向仅偏一度就会错过目的地，可见鸟类定位何等精确。

paragraphs.brief: 利用归巢本能设计放飞实验
sentences: The first systematic studies on orientation in birds were made possible by the ‘homing instinct’ exhibited by so many species.
许多鸟类都有归巢本能，最早的鸟类定向系统研究正是利用了这种本能。
Birds are caught at a time when they show an attachment to their territory, especially during the nesting season.
研究者选择鸟类依恋领地时捕捉它们，尤其是在筑巢季。
They are taken to some spot, released, and the percentage of returns is recorded.
他们把鸟带到某处放飞，再记录其中有多大比例返回。
The distance can be varied, and the direction, as well as the method of transporting them, and then the influence of climatic and other factors on their ability to find their way home can be studied.
研究者可以改变运输距离、方向和运输方式，也可以考察气候等因素如何影响鸟儿认路回巢。
These experiments have shown a wide variation in ability to home, and three types of homing behaviour have been identified.
实验显示，各种鸟的归巢能力相差很大，研究者辨认出了三种归巢行为。
paragraphs.gist: 研究者把护巢期的鸟带到别处放飞，改变放飞地点和运输条件，比较返巢比例，从中辨认出三种归巢方式。

paragraphs.brief: 视觉记忆与放飞距离的影响
sentences: In the first type, birds methodically explore the area in which they are released until they pick up some familiar feature, and then they quickly find their way back to the nest.
第一种，鸟类有条不紊地探索它们被释放的区域，直到它们发现一些熟悉的特征，然后它们很快找到回到巢穴的路。
Such birds possess a highly developed visual memory, as experiments with pigeons have shown.
这些鸟类拥有高度发达的视觉记忆，鸽子实验就证明了这一点。

Domestic pigeons have been trained to peck at a certain point on an aerial photograph, with a system of rewards, and four years later the birds were still able to respond to this training when placed on the aerial photograph.
研究者用奖励训练家鸽啄航拍照片上的特定位置，四年后再让它们面对这张照片，它们仍会啄对位置。
Birds’ eyes have a power of resolution two to three times greater than ours, enabling them to pick up very fine details.
鸟眼分辨细节的能力是人眼的两到三倍，因此能辨认出极细微的特征。
If a bird uses only this type of homing behaviour, however, it can only succeed if the point of release is not too far away.
不过，只靠这种方式归巢的鸟，只有在放飞地点离巢不太远时才能成功。
If the birds are transported 800 kilometres from their nest, it is only by good fortune that they find their way back as a result of long exploratory flights.
如果把鸟带到离巢八百公里的地方，它们长时间飞行搜索，也得靠运气才可能找到回去的路。
Usually, the area known to a bird is its feeding territory.
鸟儿熟悉的范围通常就是自己的觅食区。
Released within this area, the birds soon make their return; release them outside it and far fewer return.
在觅食区内放飞，它们很快就能返回；在区外放飞，能回来的就少得多。
However, if a bird is released for a second time in the same place, its visual memory comes into play, and the bird, no longer requiring tedious exploratory flights, will return much more quickly.
不过，第二次在同一地点放飞时，鸟会凭视觉记忆省去费时的搜索，更快回巢。
paragraphs.gist: 第一类鸟靠视觉记忆认地标，离开熟悉的觅食区后返巢率下降，但在同一地点再次放飞时会因记得来路而更快返回。

paragraphs.brief: 维持固定航向却错过目的地
sentences: The second type of homing behaviour is shown by birds that are capable of choosing their flight direction and holding to it for the rest of their journey.
第二类归巢行为见于能够选定飞行方向并一路保持航向的鸟类。
How do they decide what direction to take?
它们怎样决定朝哪边飞呢？
They appear to choose their normal migration direction even if they are released in a different place from their usual starting point.
即使放飞地点与平常的出发点不同，它们似乎也会选择惯常的迁徙方向。
If, for example, birds which normally fly to the north-east to reach latitude 45 degrees north are released at that latitude, they will immediately start flying north-east anyway.
例如，有些鸟通常向东北飞，到达北纬四十五度；即使直接在这个纬度放飞，它们还是会立即向东北飞。
So if they are released further to the west, they maintain the correct direction but fly west of their destination, and so fail to arrive.
因此，如果在更偏西的地点放飞，它们虽然保持了惯常的航向，却会从目的地西边飞过，无法抵达。
paragraphs.gist: 第二类鸟会沿惯常的迁徙方向一直飞，即使放飞地点已经改变也不修正航线，因此可能与目的地擦肩而过。

paragraphs.brief: 从陌生地点直接定向归巢
sentences: The third type of homing behaviour shows the highest degree of orientation.
第三类归巢行为显示出最高水平的定向能力。
Released at one point, the birds immediately take stock of it, compare its position with that of the nest, decide on the direction and fly off.
鸟一被放飞，就会察看周围，判断自己与巢的相对位置，选定方向飞走。
This happens even if the birds are in a country right off their migration routes, where they have never been before.
即使被放到远离惯常迁徙路线、从未到过的国家，它们也能做到这一点。
In one example, a Laysan albatross returned to its nesting area on Midway Island in the middle of the Pacific, having flown over 5,000 kilometres from the west coast of the USA in just over ten days.
有一只黑背信天翁从美国西岸飞了五千多公里，只用十天多一点就回到太平洋中部中途岛上的繁殖地。
This is a perfect example of the third type of homing, for the albatross clearly couldn’t rely on any landmarks over the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean.
这正是第三类归巢行为的典型例子，因为信天翁显然无法在浩瀚的太平洋上借助地标认路。
paragraphs.gist: 第三类鸟能从陌生地点直接定向归巢，一只黑背信天翁从美国西岸飞越没有地标的太平洋，十天多一点便回到中途岛。

paragraphs.brief: 迁徙习性与归巢成功率
sentences: The percentage of successful birds varies greatly, being highest in those species with a strong migratory behaviour.
各鸟种成功归巢的比例差异很大，迁徙习性强的鸟种最高。
Thus the lesser black-backed gull is more migratory than the herring gull and more often reaches ‘home’.
例如，小黑背鸥比银鸥更常迁徙，也更常成功归巢。
Great migrants such as the swift have the highest percentage of returns.
雨燕等善于长途迁徙的鸟类，归巢比例最高。
In one case, seven out of nine Alpine swifts were recaptured at their nests after being displaced some 1,400 kilometres; one made the journey in three days.
有一次，九只高山雨燕被带到约一千四百公里外，其中七只后来在巢里被重新捕获，有一只仅用三天便飞回了家。
paragraphs.gist: 迁徙习性越强的鸟种通常越能顺利归巢，九只被带离约一千四百公里的高山雨燕中，有七只在巢里被重新捕获。

paragraphs.brief: 幼鹳无人引导仍向西南迁徙
sentences: What part does heredity play in all this?
遗传在这些定向行为中起什么作用？
Two research studies suggest that instinctive, i.e. genetically inherited, behaviour patterns play a part in navigation.
两项研究表明，经遗传获得的本能行为模式参与了鸟类导航。
The first was carried out by Ernst Schüz and it is highly significant.
第一项研究由恩斯特·舒茨进行，结果很有意义。
Schüz caught first-year European storks and released them later, after the departure of the adult storks at a time when they normally make their south-west autumn migration to Africa.
舒茨捉住当年出生的欧洲白鹳，等成年白鹳按惯例在秋天向西南迁往非洲之后，才把这些幼鸟放飞。
The recaptures showed that, in spite of the fact that there were no adults to guide them, the birds unanimously headed south-west.
后来的重捕记录表明，即使没有成年鸟领路，所有幼鸟仍然都朝西南飞去。
This was a most striking finding, for it showed that the birds had an innate and unlearned attraction for the African wintering area that they have occupied for thousands of years.
这一发现尤其引人注目，因为它表明，这些鸟不必学习，天生就会飞向本物种几千年来一直使用的非洲越冬地。
paragraphs.gist: 研究者特意等成年白鹳离开后再放飞幼鸟，幼鸟仍一致向西南迁徙，说明它们寻找非洲越冬地的倾向可能来自遗传。

paragraphs.brief: 成年与幼年椋鸟的航向调整
sentences: The case of starlings is a little different.
椋鸟的情况稍有不同。
These birds have a great aptitude for homing, but this behaviour differs in the different age groups.
椋鸟很善于归巢，但不同年龄的鸟表现不同。
Birds that were shifted to the south-east of their normal migration route split into two groups.
被转移到惯常迁徙路线东南方的椋鸟分成了两组。

The adults, in full possession of their gift for orientation, found their wintering area by modifying their direction by 90 degrees, whereas the juveniles sought their winter quarters to the south-east of their real position.
成年鸟的定向能力已经成熟，调整九十度后找到了越冬地；幼鸟却在真正越冬地的东南方寻找越冬场所。
paragraphs.gist: 椋鸟被移离迁徙路线后，成年鸟能把方向调整九十度飞抵越冬地，幼鸟却在真正越冬地的东南方寻找落脚点。

items.en: Third type: Birds orientate correctly, even when they are released in an unfamiliar place and have no ________ to make use of.

items.en: One bird with this type of skill is the ________.

clauses: For instance, the annual migration of the golden plover of the Pacific takes it from Alaska to Hawaii on a flight of well over 3,000 kilometres, and …, it would miss the island on which it nests.
连接词 if 引出“if it were to deviate by only one degree”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
In the first type, birds methodically explore the area …, and then they quickly find their way back to the nest.

读到 which 时，回看 area，再把修饰信息接回主句。
